bullets.pwa: Built a Progressive Web App with a component-based TypeScript front end, integrated with Node.js / Express back-end services over REST APIs.
bullets.revamp: Led the UI revamp of a telecom service application, improving usability and operational efficiency.
bullets.escalation: Acted as technical point of contact and escalation for complex issues, coordinating with project managers in an Agile team.
bullets.support: Diagnosed and resolved network, hardware and operating-system issues remotely and on-site, keeping systems available.

bullets.platform: Implemented a hybrid-cloud data platform on Microsoft Azure with a data pipeline and Power BI reporting, optimizing operational time by at least 10% and reducing resource loss by at least 5%.
bullets.enterprise: Improved and maintained mission-critical enterprise applications (COSAC-Plus, COSAC-Mobile) through UI revamp projects.
bullets.coordination: Coordinated cross-functional teams and authored documentation and guidelines for smooth handovers.

bullets.sap: Developed and enhanced SAP ERP module programs and provided technical support.
bullets.requirements: Partnered with business analysts to gather requirements and advise on change impacts and technical limitations.
